hero.name: Dinh Thang
hero.description: I build end-to-end web & mobile applications, linking intuitive user interfaces with scalable backend architectures, APIs, and databases.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm a full stack developer passionate about creating complete digital products—from responsive frontend interfaces (React, Angular, Tailwind CSS) to robust backend APIs (PHP/Laravel, Node.js, MySQL, Redis).
about.p2: My expertise spans across designing intuitive client experiences, architecting RESTful services, database optimization, multi-store systems, and automated deployments.

workExperience.title: Professional Experience
responsibilities: Designing database structures and high-performance RESTful APIs for Ionic mobile applications and multi-service web platforms.
Building core business workflows including distance-based fare calculation, driver-passenger matching, food ordering, revenue reporting, and online payment integration.
Integrating AI chat, image and video generation, file and audio processing, and voice AI with token usage and payment management.
Optimizing queues and Redis for reliable AI jobs and concurrent background tasks at scale.
Building role-based access control for multi-branch SaaS systems and two-way automated Google Sheets synchronization.

professionalSkills.title: Expertise & Technology
professionalSkills.footnote: Experienced in multi-service web, mobile, and SaaS systems.

aboutPage.title: About Me
aboutPage.subtitle: Full Stack developer building seamless frontend experiences and robust backend architectures.
aboutPage.storyP1: I'm a full stack developer who enjoys building complete digital solutions. My journey spans constructing rich client-side applications as well as designing scalable backend infrastructures, databases, and background services.
aboutPage.storyP2: Over the years, I've developed and deployed multi-store e-commerce platforms, recruitment apps, travel booking engines, and customized CMS applications using PHP (Laravel), Node.js, React, Angular/Ionic, and Tailwind CSS.
aboutPage.storyP3: When I'm not writing code, you can find me exploring UI/UX trends, optimizing database query planners, or building cross-platform mini apps.
principles: Deliver seamless user experience backed by scalable code
Write clean, maintainable, and modular fullstack architectures
Automate background workers, queues, and deployments
Continuously measure, observe, and optimize performance
Enforce security and reliability across every application layer

journey.title: Started my web development journey with HTML/CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and MySQL.
Mastered Laravel framework and built custom CMS platforms and e-commerce backends.
Expanded into Frontend SPA frameworks (React.js, Angular, TypeScript) and Tailwind CSS.
Built cross-platform apps (Ionic Framework, Zalo Mini App SDK) and Redis caching layers.
Engineering fullstack ecosystems, multi-store platforms, and high-performance Web & Mobile applications.
